answer.summary: The analysis confirms that abstracts alone lack the mathematical structure required to identify recursive, integral, or delayed temporal patterns, necessitating full-text equation inspection for valid evidence of time-dependent update rules or persistence indicators
answer.content: No high-confidence instances of recursive, integral, or delayed temporal structures were found in the available abstracts. Full-text access to the mathematical content of arXiv preprints 2409.15678 to 2409.19876 is essential to detect equation-based temporal dependencies. The current evidence is insufficient to support any claim of time-dependent update rules, and the absence of explicit mathematical formulations in abstracts underscores the need for full-text analysis before concluding on temporal behavior or memory-like structures in these preprints. A bounded revision is requested to ensure only equation-based structural analysis is performed without linguistic or inferential bias.

answer.lesson: Temporal or memory-like behavior in scientific models must be grounded exclusively in explicit mathematical structures; abstract or linguistic content is insufficient for detecting recurrence, integration, or time-dependent update rules and must be excluded from analysis
